variants.name: Chicken & Rice 20 kg
variants.about_this_item: GEMON ALL BREEDS ADULT REGULAR is a complete pet food for adult dogs of every size. The formulation is characterised by topquality ingredients like chicken, a source of essential nutrients, and rice, a source of carbohydrates. The recipe is made highly digestible thanks to the extrusion process. A balanced diet with prebiotics, such as fructo-oligosaccharides (FOS), and beet pulp, source of insoluble fibres to support the regular functioning of the intestinal tract. It contains fresh meat for optimal palata-bility and glucosamine and chondroitin sulphate for joints and bone support. It also contains yucca schidigera to limit intestinal odors. No added artificial dyes and pre-ervatives.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Cereals (rice 5%), meat and animal derivatives 25% (fresh chicken meat 5%, chondroitin sulphate 0.04%), oils and fats, fish and fish derivatives, derivatives of vegetable origin (beet pulp 2%, fructo-oligosaccharides FOS 1% and yucca schidigera 0.1%), minerals, molluscs and crustaceans (glucosamine 0.026%).

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 25%, Crude Fibre: 2.5%, Crude Fat: 14%, Crude Ash: 8.0%, Calcium:1.7%, Phosphorus: 1.2%. Metabolized Energy: 3,960 kcal/kg.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 24,600 IU, Vitamin D3 1,290 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 58 mg, Choline chloride 1,000 mg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.33 mg) 0.15 mg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 69 mg) 22.5 mg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 130 mg) 105 mg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 35mg) 9 mg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 228 mg) 75 mg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 1.8mg) 1.2 mg, L-carnitine 200 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Antioxidants. SENSORY ADDITIVES: Chestnut extract 20 mg/kg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes (see table) may be split into 2 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and activity level of the animal. Be sure to have clean and fresh water available at all times. When this product replaces another type of feed and/or diet it is advised to introduce it gradually over a period of at least one week. Pet food only, not suitable for human consumption.
